cases.rationale: A yellow fire hydrant fills the foreground; actual pedestrians, a gray passenger SUV and a red double-decker bus appear across the street. The SUV is a passenger car, not a truck. A tiny pole-mounted colored assembly in the busy upper background could be a traffic signal but its signal head is unresolved, hence traffic light unclear. Signs, pavement, snow and concrete structures do not identify other category objects. I considered all 75 frozen definitions across the whole crop.

People surround an eating table beside a long upholstered couch. The standing person's gray shoulder bag supports handbag identity. A yellow squeeze bottle has a neck, drinking cups and metal bowls sit on the table, and the pink-handled utensil at the left has a spoon bowl. The bread-like topped food at upper left may be sandwich portions, but the bread-and-filling identity is too indistinct, so sandwich is unclear. Packaged food, wrappers and cloth do not support the other food or equipment definitions. I explicitly considered all 75 definitions.

A long thin surfboard deck/rail is visible at the left water surface in breaking surf. It is a board rather than a boat. Spray obscures the area near a dark protrusion and paddle-like shaft; a fallen person's possible head/body cannot be identified confidently, so person remains unclear. Water, foam and the shaft do not identify any other category object. All 75 frozen definitions were explicitly considered.

Two people stand in a room with an upholstered single-person armchair at left. Its individual-seat structure supports chair, not couch or bench; the cloth draped over it is not bedding in bed context. Motion-blurred pale objects in the people's hands could be handheld electronic controllers/remotes, but their bodies and buttons are unresolved, so remote is unclear. The floor lamp and background furniture do not identify the remaining categories. All 75 definitions were considered.

People sit behind a bar holding recognizable drinking tumblers/pint glasses, which count as cups rather than stemmed wine glasses. Bottles with necks are visible around the bar, bound book spines appear on the rear left shelving, and a round wall clock hangs at upper right. The foreground stainless basin and faucet identify a sink; the surrounding bar/work counter is excluded from dining table. No unresolved category ambiguity remains after considering every one of the 75 definitions.

Actual baseball players and partial human bodies fill the field. The low player's tan leather fielding mitt at lower right is an identifiable baseball glove; the dark gloves worn by the airborne batter are batting gloves and are excluded. Behind the fence a yellow school bus has a recognizable windowed bus body. Grass, fence and uniform details supply no other listed objects. I considered all 75 exact definitions and found no unresolved category ambiguity.

Two actual curved skateboard decks are mounted horizontally on metal wall brackets. Their deck shapes and graphics support skateboard rather than snowboard or surfboard. The metal mounting strips are hardware, not utensils or scissors, and the printed deck graphics are excluded depictions. The remaining crop is a plain wall. All 75 definitions were considered with no unresolved category ambiguity.

The meal contains identifiable broccoli florets and stalks beside orange-colored rice and meat on a flat plate; rice color does not establish carrot, and cooked meat is not an actual cattle animal. A fork's tines are visible at upper right. A further shiny utensil portion at the lower right edge lacks enough blade/bowl detail to distinguish knife from spoon, so both remain unclear. Visible wooden surface around the meal supports dining table. Every one of the 75 definitions was considered.

A woman leans on brown bedding on a bed. A red-and-gray backpack with pack body and straps lies at left, a keypad mobile phone lies at lower right, and a green bound book is at right. The black clamshell device near the bottom is a small game-console-like device rather than an identifiable laptop or standalone display. The curved black object above it has comb teeth, not remote buttons. A small clear red-filled cylindrical item near center may be a bottle but its neck/opening is unresolved, so bottle is unclear. Pouches, mittens, pens and a paper roll do not meet the other definitions. All 75 were explicitly considered.

A patterned drinking mug, a metal spoon with visible bowl and handle, and a flat food plate sit on an eating tabletop. The white rectangular topped food portions could be bread-based open sandwiches, but the coarse white texture also permits a rice-based food identity; sandwich remains unclear. The plate is not a bowl, and the patterned mug is a cup rather than a stemmed wine glass. The dark pedestal-like background object is not an identifiable listed appliance. All 75 frozen definitions were considered.

An actual elephant with trunk, broad ears, legs and heavy body stands in a sandy enclosure. The large green overhead cover is a fixed shade sail supported by separate posts, without umbrella ribs or a central umbrella structure, so umbrella is no. Vegetation grows directly in the ground, not in identifiable pots. Rocks, fencing, shelter and a hanging enrichment object do not identify other listed categories. All 75 definitions were considered, with no unresolved category ambiguity.

The open appliance has a microwave cavity, turntable, door and microwave control panel, so microwave is yes and conventional oven is no. A floral ceramic vase with a broad body and narrowing upper portion stands on top beside a radio. The transparent handled vessel inside has a pouring lip and measurement markings: it is a measuring jug rather than an identifiable drinking cup, bowl or bottle. The appliance's timer markings do not make a time-of-day clock. All 75 frozen definitions were considered and no unresolved category ambiguity remains.
